video_title: The Spurs can only PICK ONE between Harper, Fox and Castle 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' commitment to De'Aaron Fox despite his poor Finals performance
quotes.excerpt: The San Antonio Spurs have said they are 100% committed to De'Aaron Fox.
quotes.quote: The San Antonio Spurs have said they are 100% committed to De'Aaron Fox. We know one reason they are committed to him, there is one thing that has just said, that motherfucker is owed a lot of money for a lot of years and we know that.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if the Spurs should move on from De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: So are we getting rid of Fox because he had a bad series?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Okay, so are we getting rid of Fox because he had a bad series?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, his team got to the finals, but he was a pivotal reason why they were bad in the finals.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Correct. So do we get rid of him now?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox expected to remain the starting point guard
quotes.quote: The young fella already said he is okay with keeping the same role. So the decision is already made. De'Aaron Fox is starting.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' management of Dylan Harper's development and playing time
quotes.excerpt: I think the Spurs know what they have in Dylan Harper.
quotes.quote: I think the Spurs know what they have in Dylan Harper. As you can see, the last game, they just waited too fucking long, Game 5, to give him the keys and say, alright, go make the decision at the end of the game. I think they will do that a lot more this season, especially in the regular season, give him more opportunities to close games and get him more comfortable in that role.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' roster challenge with three elite guards
quotes.excerpt: You have a great problem to have, three elite guards with De'Aaron Fox, Stefan Castle, and Dylan Harper.
quotes.quote: You have a great problem to have, three elite guards with De'Aaron Fox, Stefan Castle, and Dylan Harper. But I am telling you right now, I love Dylan Harper, but it is Stefan Castle, shout out to UConn, fuck with UConn, fuck with y'all.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Castle's high upside and polished game
quotes.excerpt: I think the biggest upside is Stefan Castle.
quotes.quote: I think the biggest upside is Stefan Castle. That is my opinion. Because if he creates a jump shot, work on his handles even more, his athleticism and the way he defends is out the roof. Like, I am going to be honest with you, I think he has the biggest upside as far as to me, which you call it, is so polished and just how he plays, it is like he has been in the league already eight years, Harper. Like his game is polished, it is already there, and he can get better. Castle to me has the biggest upside of all three.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Castle's potential to become an All-Star
quotes.excerpt: If Stefan Castle gets a jump shot, he is an All-Star this year.
quotes.quote: I am going to go with what Ray said, Castle has the biggest upside if he gets the jump shot. We all know Castle gets the jump shot, he is an All-Star this year. If he comes back with a jump shot this year, he is an All-Star this year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Considering a trade of Stefan Castle and Dylan Harper for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: Would you trade Stefan Castle and Dylan Harper for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander?
quotes.quote: Would you trade Stefan Castle and Dylan Harper for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander? In San Antonio? Yes. The fuck? Shai and Wemby? Yes. I mean, yes. That is a good trade for both teams. I don't think nobody is losing. Nobody is losing. I am just saying, you imagine De'Aaron Fox and Shai?
